exclusions.reason: Legacy Cabinet Doors and Cabinet Sample Bags conflict with the current $30 collection-specific sample policy.
Unclassified display-board, cut-sample, plank-sample, strap-set and legacy flooring records are not part of the approved storefront category export.

conflicts: The public Store API still returns Napa and four owner-retired flooring colorways as published; governance excludes them from Lovable merchandising.

The current public Driftwood record exposes one Woo image and an active markdown, while the accepted isolated LVP proof had no usable image. The package withholds Driftwood imagery pending catalog-authority reconciliation but records current Woo sale state; Lovable must bind sale presentation to runtime Woo data.

The current public Hot Pursuit record exposes $12.51/sq yd regular and $9.81/sq yd current ($1.39/$1.09 per sq ft). This is recorded only because current Woo proves it; Lovable must not hard-code a crossed-out price.
Tracker is published with an invalid stored unit/price conversion. Governed presentation holds the price as PRICE COMING SOON.
Two separate Full Tread records remain in Floor Accessories (17782 and 17068); their distinction is unresolved and they must not be merged or relabeled.

The accepted local LVP proof contained six eligible fixture products; the current public Woo snapshot is broader. The six-product result remains valid proof evidence, not the full production catalog count.

Installation values were absent from the accepted local LVP fixture set. Current public category/description evidence supports only bounded values; normalized installation filtering remains false except for the explicit Glue Down category.

Woo category counts and returned product membership are not fully self-consistent (for example Cabinets reports four while the API returns the discontinued Napa record as a fifth); governed exclusions control the export.
unresolved_catalog_gaps: Most public LVP records do not expose coverage-per-box through the Store API; only Colorado Spring coverage is carried from accepted proof evidence.
Driftwood image authority and category assignment remain unresolved.
Exact compatible-accessory relationships are not generally verified; Colorado Spring has an accepted no-match proof state.
SnapCaps compatibility requires review for the exact flooring and stair profile; no universal compatibility matrix exists.
The duplicate/distinct Full Tread records require a catalog-authority decision.
Light Canoy/Light Canopy identity and Empire/Parliament manufacturer mappings remain unresolved.
Some Carpet imagery has weak resolution or cross-style filename/identity conflicts; Palmetto II/III manufacturer mapping remains incomplete.
Accessories do not expose a consistently reliable pricing unit in the Store API.
Priority1 delivery quoting is disabled/unapproved; no delivery rate or timing may be designed as a fact.
